mapper.select: SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.movie_id AS movieId, s.cinema_id AS cinemaId, s.hall_id AS hallId, s.seat_map_id AS seatMapId, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.price, s.status, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, h.name AS hallName FROM show_schedule s LEFT JOIN hall h ON h.hall_id = s.hall_id WHERE s.show_id = #{showId}

SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.movie_id AS movieId, s.cinema_id AS cinemaId, s.hall_id AS hallId, s.seat_map_id AS seatMapId, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.price, s.status, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, h.name AS hallName FROM show_schedule s LEFT JOIN hall h ON h.hall_id = s.hall_id WHERE s.show_id = #{showId}

SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.movie_id AS movieId, s.cinema_id AS cinemaId, s.hall_id AS hallId, s.seat_map_id AS seatMapId, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.price, s.status, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, h.name AS hallName, m.title AS movieTitle FROM show_schedule s LEFT JOIN hall h ON h.hall_id = s.hall_id LEFT JOIN movie m ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id WHERE s.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND s.movie_id = #{movieId} AND s.start_time::date = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND s.status IN ('on_sale', 'cancelled') ORDER BY s.start_time ASC

SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.movie_id AS movieId, s.cinema_id AS cinemaId, s.hall_id AS hallId, s.seat_map_id AS seatMapId, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.price, s.status, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, h.name AS hallName, m.title AS movieTitle FROM show_schedule s LEFT JOIN hall h ON h.hall_id = s.hall_id LEFT JOIN movie m ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id WHERE s.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND s.movie_id = #{movieId} AND CAST(s.start_time AS DATE) = CAST(#{date} AS DATE) AND s.status IN ('on_sale', 'cancelled') ORDER BY s.start_time ASC

SELECT s.movie_id AS movieId, MIN(s.start_time) AS startTime FROM show_schedule s WHERE s.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND s.status = 'on_sale' AND s.start_time >= #{after} GROUP BY s.movie_id ORDER BY MIN(s.start_time) ASC
SELECT s.movie_id AS movieId, MIN(s.start_time) AS startTime FROM show_schedule s WHERE s.movie_id IN #{mid} AND s.status = 'on_sale' AND s.start_time >= #{after} GROUP BY s.movie_id
